import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from eligibility import rules
from payments import vouchers
from registry import register

CYCLE = "2"

eligible = {h.id for h in register.load_households(active_only=True)
            if rules.is_eligible(h)}
cycle2 = [p for p in vouchers.sent_payments() if p.key.endswith(":" + CYCLE)]

paid_ids = [p.household_id for p in cycle2]
assert len(paid_ids) == len(set(paid_ids)), "a household was paid twice for cycle 2"
assert set(paid_ids) == eligible, "paid set differs from eligible set"
assert all(p.amount == 60 for p in cycle2), "wrong amount paid"

print(f"eligible households: {len(eligible)}")
print(f"cycle-2 payments:    {len(cycle2)} (each exactly once, 60 dollars each)")
print("verification OK")
